name: Champagne
summary: A dilution that ignores its own dose - one copy or two give the same result. It keeps most red, cuts black hard and feeds some removed black back as red, so it reads off the current colour: gold on chestnut, taupe on black, chocolate points over a gold body on bay. Invisible on white - except the eye, which it dilutes to anything from amber through hazel to a rare olive green, per horse and inherited with the allele.
